row.row_id: unique cohort:original-human-unit-id; never expand a block into false line labels
row.model: actual model + checkpoint/reconstructor identity, null if unknown
row.human_status: verbatim original human status; never infer from current signal
row.human_error: true/false/null: confirmed blocking vs meaning-preserved vs unjudgeable

human_label_evidence.scope_note: block/case label does not automatically apply to parts

row.pdf_sha256: original frozen PDF SHA or null
original_pages: integer original PDF pages, not local crop page indices
refs: native refs or R1 original IDs; do not dereference forbidden external R1 folders

native_evidence.visible_text: actual aligned native glyph string or null
native_evidence.primary_eligible: true only for original-PDF pypdfium ALIGNED_TEXT_LAYER_GLYPHS with explicit source bbox

reconstruction.target_text: actual reconstruction text, unmodified; null if unavailable
reconstruction.visible_text: frozen helper projection input after TeX->MathML; null if unavailable
reconstruction.mathml: converted complete unit MathML or null
reconstruction.mixed_enrichment_refs: list ref + whether actually enriched vs orig fallback; preserve exact human-adjudicated block delivery
reconstruction.prediction_refs: actual predicted item refs, separately from original/source/native refs

unknown_reasons: Computed only by integrator after explicit same-region provenance pairing.

c.bbox: actual rendered MathML bbox or null

notes: Preserve 2D grouping uncertainty, no-render semantics limitation, same-region pairing uncertainty.

a_native_orig_diagnostic.note: Optional assembled Docling orig diagnostic only; never primary a or second independent reconstructor.

row.prediction_group_id: stable model+artifact SHA+actual predicted item/ref/crop identity; original rows sharing prediction retain same group
row.duplicate_prediction_group: same as prediction_group_id if >1 original human unit refers to this prediction, else null; no ref/output similarity matching
row.primary_scope_compatible: true/false/null: feature reconstruction scope must match original human-adjudicated source-unit scope

rules: No real cohort/labels/features read while creating this schema.

Formula agent retains exactly original50 human blocks, including metadata/unknown records. Code agent retains exactly original21, including4alignment errors. Supplemental rows must use different cohort and do not enter primary denominator.
Feature availability and human-label eligibility are independent. Missing native, second reconstruction or unsupported rendering gives UNKNOWN/NO_DECISION, not semantic error. Code c=NA.
Each agent uses pinned character_helpers.py; no normalization/threshold changes after labels/features. Do not override declared human label granularity.

Native evidence uses geometry/ref/source-based aligned input. Describe any body/formula text order limitations explicitly. Do not search for target text and call successful match independent evidence.

Leave b UNKNOWN until integrator matches same PDF SHA+original page+explicit equation/ref/crop source identity. Never pair by reconstruction-string similarity. No pairing -> coverage0, not disagreement.

Multiref/multipage whole block: concatenate only when original source unit defines order and all members have explicit native provenance; otherwise a UNKNOWN. Do not distribute a block label across refs/lines.
Formula c actualChrome can run batches via render_helpers; profiles/cache/crashes onlyW3b/tmp; noexternalnetwork. Conversion-only != rendered. Unsupported macro UNKNOWN.

All metrics/ROC generated by integrator: whole human count, eligible labels count, each native/second/render available count, verified all/known/unknownlabel counts, confusion matrices on evaluable known rows, error-positive and pass-as-correct precision/recall, verified wrong CI+coverage.
R1 only specified live-preflight/round5-strict subtree; links outside must not be followed, record unavailable evidence UNKNOWN. Shared pilot PDFs allowed by SHA, holdout forbidden.
Primary a requires original PDF pypdfium character layer inside explicit original-page bbox; ALIGNED_NATIVE_ORIG is diagnostic only. If raw region missing/incomplete => a UNKNOWN.
Preserve the exact delivery channel and mixed/orig fallback composition originally human-adjudicated; an orig copy is not a second independent reconstruction.

Many-to-one prediction/source mapping: retain original human rows, report independent prediction-group counts and correlation. Do not compute primary per-source-unit CER from a larger whole-item target unless explicit source subunit target span was independently human-adjudicated. Scope mismatch => primary a UNKNOWN.
Same-model duplicates and assembled/copied orig are not independent b reconstructions. Pairing requires independent reconstructor identities as well as explicit same source region.
